other_conditions: Applicant must have own land or government‑allotted land for shrimp farming
Shrimp farm must be registered with the coastal aquaculture authority or an application for registration must have been submitted
Applicant must have his own bank account
Applicant must provide a valid identity proof such as Voter ID, Aadhaar Card, Ration Card, or Passport
For certain subsidies, the land must be leased for at least 10 years
benefits_summary: The scheme offers 50 % subsidies on a range of shrimp‑farm inputs and infrastructure (aerators, new farm construction, renovation, fencing, feed, sea‑weed culture, effluent‑treatment system, and hatchery) subject to specified monetary caps, payable either once in a lifetime or once every three years.
